items.title: Don Albert Interview, 1973-08-06
items.q: Or the same with Peck Kelly. You couldn't say Peck was like so and so. Peck was like Peck Kelly. Was he fast? Yeah, very fast.

ctx.x: But how would you describe him? Would you compare him with...

It's hard to compare an individual that has a style of his own. The same way you'd ask me to compare Lloyd Glenn possibly with Eddie Hewitt, which is two different things all together. Or the same with Peck Kelly. You couldn't say Peck was like so and so. Peck was like Peck Kelly. Was he fast? Yeah, very fast. Then you had Alan Vann that was with Troy's band. You can't compare him with Peck, but he played songs that Peck played too like Kitten on the Keys and things like that which was big in those days.
Did the Desdems ever get down there? Dan Desdems or Clarence Desdems? Did you ever meet them?
